korea_market_exposure: YouTube Premium Lite and YouTube Music are officially marketed in Korea
best_proxy_if_not: Alphabet consolidated ETR plus APAC revenue share plus foreign cash tax totals and indirect KR music panel proxies
why_visibility_is_limited: Alphabet 10-K discloses YouTube Music inside Google Services, revenue by large geographies only (United States, EMEA, APAC, Other Americas), and foreign cash taxes only as Brazil plus Other, so Korea-specific tax incidence cannot be isolated directly

korea_market_exposure: Direct music-streaming service bundled inside YouTube Premium in Korea
best_proxy_if_not: Alphabet consolidated ETR plus Korea-facing music panel proxies
why_visibility_is_limited: YouTube Music has no standalone public entity-level tax filing in the materials reviewed and is disclosed only as part of Alphabet's broader Google Services subscription revenue, creating a service-versus-entity mismatch

korea_market_exposure: Spotify Premium has an official Korea pricing page and KR music-market exposure
best_proxy_if_not: Spotify consolidated ETR plus matched FY2025 Dreamus-versus-Spotify tax comparison
why_visibility_is_limited: Spotify 20-F discloses tax at consolidated level and geography at major regions; South Korea appears as office footprint, not as a separate tax line or reporting segment, so Korea-specific tax incidence is not directly separable

korea_market_exposure: Apple Music is officially marketed in Korea and sits inside Apple's broader Services segment
best_proxy_if_not: Apple consolidated foreign tax totals plus Rest of Asia Pacific segment data
why_visibility_is_limited: Apple 10-K reports segments as Americas, Europe, Greater China, Japan, and Rest of Asia Pacific and reports foreign tax totals, but gives no Korea-specific tax line; Apple Music is only one service inside the broader Services segment
